mods.shieldWidget.Step.Length.description,Size of each step. Higher moves in bigger jumps.
mods.travelOptions.CautiousTravel.FatigueMinimumValue.description,Level of fatigue that will automatically pause the journey when travelling cautiously, absolute value
account.refusal.profSpec,That specialization is not one this craft offers.
mods.travelOptions.CautiousTravel.HealthMinimumPercentage.description,Level of health that will automatically pause the journey when travelling cautiously, as a percentage
mods.travelOptions.CautiousTravel.MaxChanceToAvoidEncounter.description,Maximum chance to avoid an encounter when travelling cautiously, as a percentage
mods.travelOptions.CautiousTravel.PlayerControlledCautiousTravel.description,Enables the travel option "Cautiously" to initiate time accelerated travel, instead of vanilla fast travel
mods.travelOptions.CautiousTravel.SpeedPenalty.description,Speed penalty for travelling cautiously, as a percentage

mods.travelOptions.Enabled.description,Choose between the original game’s fast travel and a journey you make yourself, sped up to 60 times, with a panel to steer it. Encounters and places along the way stop you, and you can follow the roads. Off brings back the classic travel map with fast travel only.
mods.travelOptions.FastTravelCostScaling.FastTravelCostScaleFactor.description,Scales the cost of inns when using standard fast travel, suggest x4-x6 for Climate & Calories.
mods.travelOptions.FastTravelCostScaling.ShipTravelCostScaleFactor.description,Scales the cost of ships when using standard fast travel, suggest x2-x3 for Climate & Calories.
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.AllowAnnoyingSounds.description,Allows footstep and hoof sounds during time accelerated travel
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.AllowRealGrass.description,Has no effect here: Real Grass isn’t included.
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.AllowTargetingMapCoordinates.description,Allows travel map to target any coordinates using time accelerated travel
account.refusal.profSpecStale,Your specialization changed elsewhere. Look again before you choose.
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.AllowWeather.description,Allows weather effects during time accelerated travel
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.AvoidObstacles.description,Steers time accelerated travel around buildings, walls and rocks, and pauses the journey before walking into something it can’t get round.

mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.FirstPersonTravel.description,Makes time accelerated journeys in first person, on the ground. Off, the enhanced interface makes them in the Overworld view. Takes effect at once.

mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.FirstPersonTravelFollowsRoads.description,With First Person Travel on, journeys follow the roads and tracks as Overworld journeys do, and a place with no way there by land can’t be picked. Off, you head straight for your destination. Takes effect at once.
mods.travelOptions.GeneralOptions.LocationPause.description,Auto pause when encountering a game location during real time accelerated travel
mods.travelOptions.LocationColours.description,The colour shown on the travel map
account.refusal.profSpecTaken,A specialization was chosen there already. Look again.
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.Enable.description,Enhances the travel map with larger location dots for cities & towns, and shows roads & tracks with toggle buttons
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.EnableStreamsToggle.description,Adds a streams toggle button separate from rivers button
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.EnableWaterways.description,Enhances the travel map with rivers and streams with a toggle button
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.FollowPathsCustomKeyBind.description,Custom key bind for following paths used if CustomBind set above
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.FollowPathsKey.description,Sets the key to initiate time accelerated travelling following paths if roads integration enabled
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.MarkLocationColor.description,The colour used to highlight locations using middle mouse button on travel map
mods.travelOptions.RoadsIntegration.VariableSizeDots.description,All locations, except for cities & towns, are rendered as smaller dots
account.refusal.profTemper,That piece cannot be tempered. Smiths temper weapons and metal armor, and tailors temper leather and cloth.
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.BackgroundColor.description,The opaque background color to use for the mini-map
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.Circular.description,Draw the mini-map in a circle around the player
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.FilterMode.description,Pixel filtering to use when rendering the mini-map
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.Opaque.description,Render the mini-map with an opaque background color
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.PersistentMap.description,Set this to have the junction mini-map always displayed when following paths
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.PlayerColor.description,The colour of the player position and direction indicator
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.ScreenPositionX.description,The X coordinate the mini-map is rendered on the screen
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.ScreenPositionY.description,The Y coordinate the mini-map is rendered on the screen
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.ScreenSize.description,The width and height the mini-map is rendered on the screen
account.refusal.profTemperStale,That piece's quality has changed. Check your Stores again.
mods.travelOptions.RoadsJunctionMap.ToggleMapOffPaths.description,Set this to have the junction mini-map toggled when follow key pressed and not on a path
mods.travelOptions.ShipTravel.OnlyFromPorts.description,Restricts ship travel to be possible only from places with ports
mods.travelOptions.ShipTravel.OnlyToPorts.description,Restricts ship travel to be possible only if destination has a port, if from ports setting is enabled
mods.travelOptions.StopAtInnsTravel.PlayerControlledInnsTravel.description,Enables the stop for night travel option "Inns" to initiate time accelerated travel, instead of fast travel
mods.travelOptions.Teleportation.EnablePaidTeleportation.description,Enable paid Mages teleportation service for all guild members, before rank 8

mods.unleveledLoot.Enabled.description,Loot and shop stock no longer scale with your level. What materials drop depends on your luck, the shop’s quality and the type of dungeon, and the gold you find follows your luck. Off uses Daggerfall Unity’s rolls.
mods.unleveledLoot.MaterialSwitching.description,Whenever this material would drop, change it to the selected material.

mods.warmAshesShips.Enabled.description,When you travel by ship, 1 trip in 4 is attacked by pirates. You fight them on deck beside your crew, on a borrowed ship if you don’t own one, then land where you were going.
mods.weaponWidget.Bob.BobWhileIdle.description,Whether the weapon will slightly bob while stationary
mods.weaponWidget.Bob.Length.description,Amount of bobs in a single stride
account.refusal.profTemperTop,That piece cannot be tempered any further. Tempering stops at Superior, and a Masterwork cannot be tempered.
mods.weaponWidget.Bob.Offset.description,Advances the bob timing. For use with weapon bob.
mods.weaponWidget.Bob.SpeedMove.description,Speed of transition between stationary and moving

mods.weaponWidget.Enabled.description,Livelier first-person weapons: swings that wind up and recover, the weapon in the hand you swing with, a sheathe animation, a bob as you walk, sway as you look and a kick when you hit or parry. The Morrowind arms move the same way.
mods.weaponWidget.Inertia.ForwardDepth.description,Multiplier for the change in scale when moving forward or backward
mods.weaponWidget.Inertia.ForwardSpeed.description,The speed that the sprite will scale towards the target depth
mods.weaponWidget.Inertia.Scale.description,The maximum distance that the sprite will be offset
account.refusal.profTransmuter,Only a Transmuter can turn one metal into the next. Choose it at Alchemy 100, under Provisioning.
mods.weaponWidget.Inertia.Speed.description,The speed that the sprite will move at towards the target offset
mods.weaponWidget.Miscellaneous.MirrorTwoHandedAxes.description,Draws a two-handed axe mirrored in the right hand.
mods.weaponWidget.Miscellaneous.MirrorTwoHandedBlunts.description,Draws a two-handed staff, hammer or flail mirrored in the right hand.
mods.weaponWidget.Miscellaneous.MirrorTwoHandedSwords.description,Draws a two-handed sword mirrored in the right hand.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Ambidexterity.description,Ambidexterity: the weapon shows in the hand you swing with (Switch Hand, H), mirrored for the left.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Bob.description,Bob: the sprite sways as you walk.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.DoubleScaleTextures.description,DoubleScaleTextures: draws the idle pose at double size from the mod’s own textures. Add the mod’s .dfmod under Your own textures.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Inertia.description,Inertia: the weapon trails behind as you look around and move. Needs double-scaled weapon textures.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Offset.description,Offset: sheathing slides the sprite off the screen and drawing slides it back; a swing returns from below.
account.refusal.profTrialOver,The free day to change this specialization has ended. Nothing was spent - look again before you choose.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Recoil.description,Recoil: the swing bounces back on a hit, parry or miss, as set below.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Step.description,Step: the sprite’s position is rounded so it moves in steps.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.Swings.description,Swings: each strike winds up from the idle pose, plays at its own speed and recovers, in reverse after a hit.
mods.weaponWidget.Modules.TrueTextureSize.description,TrueTextureSize: a custom texture is drawn at its own pixel size, divided by the scale factor below.
mods.weaponWidget.Offset.Speed.description,Speed of the slide on and off the screen.
account.refusal.progressPlay,You have earned all that your play so far allows. Keep playing and it comes back.
account.refusal.progressSeat,Only the realm character you are playing earns that, and it is now open on another device. Open it here again to keep earning.

mods.weaponWidget.Recoil.DetectEnvironment.description,A swing into a wall or a door within reach recoils too.
mods.weaponWidget.Recoil.MissEffectPlacement.description,Where the clang or thud is drawn.
mods.weaponWidget.Recoil.PlayEntityMissEffects.description,A clang or a thud at a foe that parried or was missed.
mods.weaponWidget.Recoil.PlayEnvironmentMissEffects.description,A thud where the swing met the wall.
mods.weaponWidget.Step.Condition.description,Whether the snapping only affects Sheathing or also other options like Bob, Inertia and Recoil
mods.weaponWidget.Step.Length.description,Size of each step. Higher moves in bigger jumps.
mods.weaponWidget.Swings.NoDaggerMirroredStrikes.description,Prevents Daggers from using the opposite hand animations
mods.weaponWidget.Swings.VanillaAlignmentOverride.description,Centres the down and up strikes of the vanilla weapons at the screen’s middle edge.
mods.weaponWidget.Swings.VanillaRecoveryOverride.description,Plays the StrikeUp animation in reverse during recovery for some vanilla weapons
mods.weaponWidget.Swings.Windup.description,What shows while the swing winds up.
mods.weaponWidget.TrueTextureSize.TextureScaleFactor.description,With True Texture Size on, divides a custom texture’s size. Raise it if the weapon draws too large.

mods.worldEventsRaidingParties.Enabled.description,Knights, bandits or orcs raid towns across Tamriel for 2 hours. With the town guard, beat 15 to 25 raiders to free the town and raise your standing in the region. Online, everyone in town fights the same raid.

mods.worldOfDaggerfall.Enabled.description,More to find in the wilderness: bandit camps and forts, ruins, shrines, mountains and rock fields across the Iliac Bay, with bandits, bears and treasure, and a camp outside Privateer’s Hold.

mods.worldTooltips.Enabled.description,Shows the name of what you’re looking at under the crosshair: people, shops and their opening hours, doors and their locks, where an exit leads, levers, ladders, bookshelves and Daedra waiting to be summoned. Off, you still see what a chest or body holds.
account.refusal.qlBody,That questline step could not be claimed.
mods.worldTooltips.HideDefaultInteractTooltip.description,Hides the label on things that may be meant to stay secret, such as the puzzles of the main quest.

prof.page.how.alchemy,Brew on the Crafting page at an alchemy station: Alchemists, Mages Guild halls and your home have one. It brews the classic potion maker's 20 recipes from what you carry or store. Elsewhere, a potion maker earns no Provisioning experience.

prof.page.how.building,Carpentry needs a workbench: Furniture Stores, joineries and your home have one. It saws logs into planks and makes staves, bows, arrows and furniture. A mason's bench, in General Stores and your home, cuts stone and mixes Mortar.
prof.page.how.cooking,Cook at any lit fire: a campfire, a hearth or a brazier. Stand close to the flame. Dishes use the meat you skin, the fish you net, herbs and Basket finds, and go to your pack.

prof.page.how.enchanting,Enchanting rises as you break crafted pieces into Arcane Essence at an enchanting station, on the Crafting page. Mages Guild halls and your home have one. {off, select, yes {The item maker costs you {pct}% less.} other {From Journeyman on, the item maker costs you less.}}

prof.page.how.fishing,With a Fishing-Net in your pack, fish while standing or swimming in water, or aboard a ship, at any hour. Hold the use key to draw back and release to cast. When the floats dip, press it again. Then hold to raise the band and release to lower it, keeping the net's weight inside the band to fill the net. Cast at a rising school for an extra fish.
account.slots.notHeld,Not yours yet. Point at it to try it on.

prof.page.how.herbalism,Press the use key at a patch of herbs in the wilderness. Common herbs need no tool; the rest need a Sickle in your pack. With a Basket, the patch's list also lets you search it for food. The Sickle and the Basket can be used from your hotbar or quick slots as well. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.hunting,With a Skinning Knife in your pack, you can skin a creature you killed. Hold the use key at the start of the line and drag the knife along it. Used from your hotbar or a quick slot, the knife is held for you: follow the line with your eyes. The carcass's list also lets you search it.

prof.page.how.logging,Press the use key at a tree in the wilderness. You need a Wood-Axe in your pack. Only some trees in each place can be felled each day. The axe can also be used from your hotbar or quick slots. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.mining,Press the use key at a vein of ore or a boulder in the wilderness, or at a vein in a dungeon. You need a Pick-Axe in your pack. The pick can also be used from your hotbar or quick slots. Used from your pack, a tool only tells you where it can be used.

prof.page.how.miningGround,Veins hold Silver at most until three different players, each with an account at least a week old, have gathered on that ground. Then Gold, Platinum and Mithril in the mountains, and the region's own ore, can appear. Deep veins in dungeons can hold any of their ores, Dwarven Scrap and Adamantium among them, in any dungeon; only a woodland dungeon's Moonstone waits for three players to gather in it. Point at open ground on the world map to see what its veins hold and whether it has been witnessed yet.
prof.page.how.miningSurveyor,As a {name}, you need no witnesses: your veins can give any ore the land holds. A region's own ore still needs the other players.

prof.page.how.outfitting,Outfitting needs a loom: Clothing Stores and your home have one. It cures hides into leather, weaves Root Tendrils into Linen and spins furs into Wool. It makes leather armor, clothing, rugs and tapestries. Weavers sell Linen and Wool too.

prof.page.how.smithing,Smith at a forge: Weaponsmiths, Armorers and your home have one. It smelts ore into ingots; its anvil makes weapons, armor and tools, even from raw ore. Jewelry needs a jeweler's bench, in Pawn Shops, Gem Stores and your home.
